hooks.command: LOG="$HOME/.learning-curve/hook.log"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.learning-curve" && { echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) [$$] started" >> "$LOG"; PYTHONPATH="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" uv run -q --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -m learning_curve.course session-end 2>>"$LOG"; rc=$?; echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) [$$] finished exit=$rc" >> "$LOG"; }
